## Props (PhotoCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` |  |
| `alt` | `string` |  |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | The tile's LONG edge: xs 80 (RecipeLinkCard, no badge) · sm and md 192 · lg 288 (PhotoStrip). @default 'md' |
| `format` | `'square' \| 'portrait' \| 'landscape'` | The tile's shape. Portrait and landscape are both 3:4, so a size gives 80/192/288 on the long edge and 60/144/216 on the short one. Defaults per size: xs squ… |
| `score` | `number \| null` | 0–100; renders the verdict as an elevated reaction Badge, bottom-right. |
| `verdict` | `string` |  |
| `badge` | `BadgeProps` | Any Badge instead of the verdict. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | 2px primary ring. |
| `favorite` | `boolean` | Is it a favourite? Fills the heart and turns it destructive-text; false leaves it outlined. |
| `onToggleFavorite` | `() => void` | Makes the heart pressable and shows it even when `favorite` is false. Without it the heart is a marker. |
| `children` | `unknown` | Extra overlays, e.g. a favourite heart. |
